messages:
Priya: Heads-up: we're getting alerts for increased 5xxs on embeddings.read in us-east1 starting ~11:12 UTC. Customers reporting timeouts. Posting a short status and opening thread: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2801234567 :rotating_light:
Infra-Bot: Incident INC-2801234567 created. Runbook: https://internal.redwood.ai/runbooks/embeddings-read-deg. Pager: oncall.
Jordan (oncall): Acknowledged. Pulling traces + delayed request samples. Initial triage shows elevated egress retries to our mirror tier and TCP resets from proxy-eu-east-1.
Marta: Infra: temporarily enabling per-tenant egress soft-limits and bumping read worker pool by 30%. Also toggling connection keepalive and socket timeouts on the proxy for graceful drains.
Priya: Mitigation plan: 1) soft-limits per-tenant 2) autoscale read-workers 3) route heavy tenants to reduced-shard mode if needed. Notify CS once we have a stable window.
Jordan (oncall): Soft-limits applied (policy id: soft-egress-03). Autoscale executed: +30% read capacity. Early signal: error rate from 9.7% -> 2.9% within 4m. P95 latency still ~200ms above baseline.
DevRel: Drafting a short customer message: "We're seeing transient errors on embeddings.read in us-east1 for some high-throughput workloads. Mitigations in progress; monitoring. We'll follow up with details and RCA." Approve to publish?
Priya: Approve. Mark impacted accounts for targeted outreach; include workaround (smaller batch sizes) in the note.
Jordan (oncall): Observed a recurring spike tied to node eu-east-proxy-5 reporting repeated resets. Scheduling a cordon and replacement if it remains noisy after drains.
Marta: Collecting connection dumps and packet stats; opening downstream partner ticket for mirror rate-limits. Adding partner ops channel: #partner-us-mirror.
Ops-Bot: INC-2801234567 update: mitigations active, monitoring. Logs: https://logs.redwood.ai/2801234567  CI run: https://ci.redwood.ai/runs/82007
Jordan (oncall): Healthcheck: `./bin/healthcheck --svc embeds-read --region us-east1 --samples 60` -> 57/60 ok, 3 timed out on proxied node. Continuing to monitor for 30m.
Priya: Customer impact summary: partial degradation for a small set of high-throughput tenants in us-east1; most customers unaffected. Status page updated.
Marta: If node continues failing, we'll cordon and redeploy patch for keepalive regressions. Also collecting GC traces for the model cache on read nodes.
Jordan (oncall): Next steps: monitor, collect failed request IDs (tag INC-2801234567), prepare to escalate if 5xx >3% for next 15m. If stable for 1h we'll post an interim summary + RCA stub.
DevRel: Exec one-liner for comms: "Transient embeddings.read errors in us-east1; rate-limits + autoscaling restored majority of traffic; postmortem forthcoming." :white_check_mark:
Priya: Thanks everyone. Keeping thread open while we watch. If anything spikes ping #incidents-escalation and I'll re-escalate the pager.
